name: drenching-finish-on-kill-requires-class-bonus
notes: Drenching Finish (en3DD836cp): the On Kill is a "[Class Bonus]". With the plain Spirit of Water (class SPIRIT, not WARRIOR) as champion the Training Dummy still dies but no player is asked for and no card is milled.

rulesClauses: The On Kill is a [Class Bonus]: no mill without a WARRIOR champion.
